🟢 Backend Status Indicators

● Live Cloud: Connected to official provider API with valid authentication tokens.
● Simulated: Credentials absent, placeholder, or on hold. Changes mirror safely into local folder ./cloud_simulation/<provider> without network errors.
● Attention / Failed: Token expired or rejected by provider. Re-generate token using the Python scripts in scripts/ or verify provider portal.
